_classes.name: technical-correction reprints: citation renumbering or gender-word swap stored as records
_classes.rule: python (/tmp/auditB_classes.py, refined): rebuild the post-amendment text from the packet with a per-char braced flag; take the braced chars inside the stored quote; match if extends_existing and, after removing number words/digits, citation words (section|subsection|paragraph|of|this|the|financial services law|chapter|article|and|or|hereof|that|which), gender/title words (he|his|her|superintendent('s)|commissioner('s)) and punctuation, no letters remain; braced text holds a citation or gender word; no year, 'dollars' or 'percent'.
_classes.note: Rule finds 9 of the 14 sample instances (misses -03 days', -09, -12 hyphen, -13, -14: quote spans or apostrophe/hyphen tokens); 1459 records could not be located in packet text. Gate reprinted_gender_neutral caught only -10.

_classes.name: Municipalities (all) where the law names a narrower group (assessing units; defined municipality)
_classes.rule: agency=='Municipalities (all)' and (re.search(r'assessing unit', actor_raw, re.I) or not re.match(r'\s*(all |the )?municipalit', actor_resolved_model, re.I))
_classes.note: 218 of 1193 Municipalities (all) records; laws that define 'municipality' broadly but the model kept the bare word are not caught (needs_judgment for those).
